keyPoints.en: First: If + present, will + V (real future).
keyPoints.bm: First: If + present, will + V (masa depan mungkin).

keyPoints.en: Second: If + past, would + V (imagined present; "If I were…").
keyPoints.bm: Second: If + past, would + V (andaian kini; "If I were…").

keyPoints.en: Third: If + had + V3, would have + V3 (imagined past, regrets).
keyPoints.bm: Third: If + had + V3, would have + V3 (andaian lalu, penyesalan).

keyPoints.en: Passive = be + V3; the doer comes after "by" (optional).
keyPoints.bm: Pasif = be + V3; pelaku hadir selepas "by" (pilihan).

keyPoints.en: Use it when the doer is unknown or unimportant, and in formal writing.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan apabila pelaku tidak diketahui atau tidak penting, dan dalam penulisan formal.

keyPoints.en: Match "be" to the tense: is built / was built / has been built / will be built.
keyPoints.bm: Padankan "be" dengan kala: is built / was built / has been built / will be built.

keyPoints.en: Backshift tenses: am/is → was; will → would; can → could.
keyPoints.bm: Undurkan kala: am/is → was; will → would; can → could.

keyPoints.en: Change pronouns and time/place words (now → then, here → there).
keyPoints.bm: Tukar kata ganti dan kata masa/tempat (now → then, here → there).

keyPoints.en: Questions: asked + if/wh-word + statement order, no question mark.
keyPoints.bm: Soalan: asked + if/kata tanya + susunan penyata, tanpa tanda soal.

keyPoints.en: Use commas around extra information: "My brother, who lives in KL, is a doctor."
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan koma untuk maklumat tambahan: "My brother, who lives in KL, is a doctor."

tip.en: Relative clauses help you combine short sentences — great for writing marks.
tip.bm: Klausa relatif membantu menggabungkan ayat pendek — bagus untuk markah penulisan.
